title: DYNAMOD
description: A mod that adds DYNAMITE. More Updates Soon
body:
A mod that adds a dynamite block to the game. This block can be crafted with 3 TNT and 1 Redstone Dust.
![Dynamite Item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6a82181ff4e168fe3989ba3bc58af2120012431_0.webp)
It can be triggered by right click, redstone, a projectile (like an arrow), and other explosions. And yes, you can chain them in a row and blow up everything instantly! 

My performance tests have resulted with not too much lag when ignited, however there might be little freeze when the game is processing the explosion. However **PLEASE DO NOT USE /FILL TO FILL AN AREA WITH EXCESSIVE AMMOUNTS DYNAMITE!!!** It is extremely laggy for the game to simply render and results in a slideshow of FPS. The game will also crash if there are too many dynamites chaining each other even if they are just blowing up air. 

Thanks for Reading all of this and have fun!
